name: Barramundi Group Ltd.
summary: Barramundi Group Ltd. focuses on the aquaculture and commercialization of barramundi fish. The company manages three marine farming operations located in Australia, Singapore, and Brunei. It supplies a broad selection of chilled and frozen barramundi items, available in formats such as single servings, multi-portion packages, larger fillets, and bespoke cuts, catering to both corporate (B2B) and individual (B2C) clients. Additionally, the group markets various specialized co-products, including swim bladders, heads, bones, and scales. A further facet of its business involves the development and provision of autogenous vaccines to other aquaculture enterprises. Barramundi Group promotes its products to chefs, restaurants, and business affiliates through its recognized brands, Kühlbarra and Cone Bay. The company was founded in Singapore in 2007, where its main offices are located.
